12505: São Francisco de Assis do Piauí

it.txt: Era vice-governador e assumiu em 11/03/2022 depois da renúncia de Mauro Carlesse; foi eleito governador em 2022
it.txt_en: He was vice governor. He became governor on March 11, 2022, after Mauro Carlesse resigned. He was then elected governor in 2022.
